title: India, 2050 (imagined)
tagline: An imagined year, built on named plans and projections. Nothing here is a prediction.

locale.persona: an imagined urban household in India (not a real family)
locale.placeNameNote: Period place names with today's name in brackets on first mention, e.g. Bombay (now Mumbai).

morningRoutine.activity: A heat advisory on the phone
morningRoutine.detail: In this imagined 2050 the day starts with a heat advisory, because heatwaves like the 2010 one that reached 53 C might be more frequent and planned for.
A phone might translate speech between India's widely spoken languages fluently, as an ordinary utility.
The electricity grid might be well on the way to the 2070 net-zero pledge, with coal a smaller share of supply.
The Bharatiya Antariksh Station, planned for completion by 2035, might have been staffed for years.

technology.name: An Indian space station in orbit (imagined)
technology.description: The Bharatiya Antariksh Station is planned today to weigh about 52 tonnes, orbit near 400 km and be complete by 2035. By 2050 it might have been staffed for years and be due for replacement.

technology.name: Routine crewed flights (imagined)
technology.description: Gaganyaan is designed to carry three people to low Earth orbit; by 2050 crewed flights might be unremarkable.

technology.name: A grid closer to net zero (imagined)
technology.description: India has said it aims for net-zero emissions by 2070; by 2050 the electricity grid might be well on the way, with coal a smaller share of supply.

technology.name: Everyday machine translation (imagined)
technology.description: With dozens of widely spoken languages, a phone that translates speech between them fluently might be an ordinary utility by 2050.

technology.name: Audio-first reading (imagined)
technology.description: Many readers might listen in their own language while commuting.

futureVisions.prediction: By 2100 cities might be planned around heat first, with shade, water and night-time hours built into the street.
